h1.written: 2026-10-08T10:0xZ owner in chat: "Forty day challenge main title could be forty day challenge" — his words, the title's own capital (the UX delegation of 10-07); the home's door keeps his sheet line

step3.text: A verse a day for forty days — let God change your life a morning at a time.

explanation.text: Forty days is not a test. Nothing here is earned — God forgave you when you asked Him. The forty days are simply forty mornings of the three rules, said again. Each morning there is one verse, the same for everyone who holds this card, and the three rules under it. Read the verse. Use the rules. If you miss a morning, there is nothing to make up — start again where you are. On the fortieth day nothing ends. The rules are for every day after that one.

_struck.why: the h1 is now his title; a second title line would repeat it (owner 2026-10-08)

what.text: One short mail a morning for forty days: the day's verse and the three rules. Nothing else.

stop.text: Stop any day with one tap. We delete your address after day 47.

age.text: 18 or older, or join with a parent.

hold.text: We hold only your email and your language, to send the forty.

what_happens.text: Pressing the button opens [the list vendor]'s page, where you confirm from your inbox.

h1.text: Print the card and give it.

step2.text: Send it to a print shop, or print it at home — ten cards fit on one sheet (twelve on long bond).

step3.text: Cut on the marks. Keep one, give the rest.

shop.text: Both sides · flip on the long edge · 100 %, no scaling · short bond, long bond or A4 · board paper if the shop has it

no_duplex.text: No two-sided printer? Print page 1, put the sheet back, print page 2.

send_shop.text: Send the sheet to a print shop

close.text: A card weighs nothing. In a hand it can carry a whole life home.

honest_number._note: his typed line only, with its date — e.g. '[N] cards given since [year]. Counted by hand.' — from the giver's paper count; absent until then

play._note: the figures from the master (film.json), never a guess; the door exists only when hasFilm

who_reads_named.text: Write to [name]. He reads every message himself.

testimony.text: Did you pray the prayer? Tell us what happened. If you'd like your words on this page, say so — first name or initials only, never your surname or a photo; we take them down the day you ask. Under 18? A parent says yes first.

low_day.text: Not doing well? Say so. You don't have to write it well. Rule 1 still works today.

mail_body.text:
Did you pray the prayer? Tell us what happened.

May we put your words on 3r4l.org with your first name only? Write YES or NO here:
mail_body._note: the mailto body: the consent is a QUESTION the sender answers in their own hand (RA 10173 §3(b)); never a pre-written yes

what.text: What we hold: for the forty days, your email address and your language; if you write to us, your message and the name you give.

why.text: Why: to send you one verse a day for forty days; to reply to you.

how_long.text: How long: the forty days and seven more, or until you stop — one tap in every mail; messages until we have replied, then deleted, unless you wrote that we may share them.

processors.text: Who processes it for us: [the list vendor] sends the mails; Cloudflare routes our email.

rights.text: Your rights under the Data Privacy Act of 2012: to see, correct or delete what we hold, and to complain to the National Privacy Commission.

children.text: Children: 18 or older, or with a parent.

no_tracking.text: No cookies, no tracking, no advertising on this site.

mails._note: the 41 mails are built zero-model at rung 7 from verses.json (the KJV text) + card.txt (the three rules, sliced) + sheet.json + these frames; no devotional line; {n} and {ref} are filled per mail and never appear on a page

day0.text: You asked for the forty. Day 1 comes tomorrow morning: 1 John 1:9. Until then the card is at 3r4l.org.

day40.text: That is the forty. Nothing ends today — the rules are for every day after this one.
